```html
<div class="bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold py-4 px-8 rounded-md shadow-lg mx-auto mt-16">
    <div wire:key="{{ $shortLink->id }}">
        <h2>{{ $shortLink->title }}</h2>
        <p>Click {{ $shortLink->clicks }} times</p>
        <button class="bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded-md shadow-lg mt-4" wire:click="copyToClipboard('{{ $shortLink->short_url }}')">Copy Link</button>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        Alpine.data('ShortLinkComponent', () => ({
            shortLink: null,
            copyToClipboard(url) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => {
                    alert('Link copied to clipboard!');
                }).catch(err => {
                    console.error('Failed to copy link:', err);
                });
            }
        }));
    });
</script>
```
